校准顺序：接好大地、校准池放进屏蔽盒后，先做必做的 Calibrate Inst: Calibration order: after connecting earth ground and placing the calibration cell in the shield, first run the required Calibrate Instrument. Then, as needed, run DC Low I (when sample impedance is very high; it must come after Calibrate Instrument and use the same cable), cable capacitance calibration (when the phase shows glitches) and temperature measurement calibration (when using a thermocouple). Send the instrument back to Gamry for factory calibration every 1 to 2 years.
Calibrate Instrument 接线：机壳接大地；电缆五根彩色导线接: Calibrate Instrument wiring: connect the chassis to earth ground; plug the five colored leads of the cable into the matching jacks of the 200-ohm calibration cell; place the calibration cell in the closed Calibration Shield and connect the black floating-ground lead to the shield's ground post. Menu: Experiment, Utilities, Calibrate Instrument.
DC Low I 校准接线（按软件提示窗口）：绿色 WE 和蓝色 WS 夹在一起: DC Low I calibration wiring (as the software prompt window shows): clip the green WE and blue WS together and place them inside the Faraday shield, not touching the walls; connect the black floating-ground lead to the shield; clip the white RE, orange CS and red CE together and leave them outside the shield; click OK when connected.
电缆电容校准接线：电缆接 20 千欧校准池，放进盖好的屏蔽盒，黑线接接地柱，机壳: Cable capacitance calibration wiring: connect the cable to the 20-kilohm calibration cell and place it in the closed shield; connect the black lead to the ground post and the chassis to earth ground. Menu: Experiment, Utilities, Calibrate Cable Capacitance.
温度测量校准：自备 K 型热电偶插到后面板 T/C Type K 插孔，按软件提: Temperature measurement calibration: plug your own Type K thermocouple into the T/C Type K jack on the rear panel. Following the software prompts, place it first in an ice-water bath at 0 °C, then in boiling water at about 100 °C, for a two-point calibration.
先定目标尺寸：夹层池填满 PTFE 垫片的孔，厚度等于垫片厚度；纽扣电池用 18: First set the target size: in a sandwich cell, the film fills the hole of the PTFE spacer and its thickness equals the spacer thickness; in a coin cell, use an 18 to 19 mm disc, a size larger than the 16 mm spacer; with a PP ring, fill the hole and scrape it flat.
按材料状态选制膜方法：能溶于溶剂用溶液浇铸；加热能熔融或软化用无溶剂热压；液态前: Choose the film-making method by material state: if it dissolves in a solvent, use solution casting; if it melts or softens when heated, use solvent-free hot pressing; cure a liquid precursor in place in the hole; fill very soft, sticky materials into the hole directly or by melt filling.
溶液浇铸：按目标厚度算好溶液用量，倒进放水平的 PTFE 培养皿，盖子留缝让溶剂: Solution casting: calculate the amount of solution for the target thickness and pour it into a leveled PTFE dish; leave the lid ajar so the solvent evaporates slowly. Thickness t equals solute mass divided by the product of density and area. Vacuum dry to constant weight; residual solvent and moisture make the conductivity falsely high.
无溶剂热压：电解质放在两张离型膜之间，两侧放已知厚度的垫片，用加热压板压平，垫片: Solvent-free hot pressing: place the electrolyte between two release films, with spacers of known thickness on both sides, and press flat with heated platens; the spacer thickness is the film thickness. Cool under pressure, then remove. Set the temperature for the material, not above its decomposition temperature. Beware of burns.
冲片：膜连同上下离型膜放在预冷的金属块上，用冲刀冲出圆片；先冷却变硬边缘才整齐；: Punching: place the film, together with its upper and lower release films, on a pre-chilled metal block and punch out a disc with a punch. Cool it first so it stiffens and the edges come out clean. Use a punch, not scissors, and do not pull on the film; re-measure the diameter after punching.
称重估厚度：圆片称得 36.0 毫克，直径 19 毫米、密度 1.25 克每立方: Thickness by weighing: a disc weighing 36.0 mg, with a 19 mm diameter and a density of 1.25 g/cm³, has an average thickness of about 102 µm. This gives the average thickness without touching the film; compare it with the micrometer reading.
转移：带着离型膜把膜放到不锈钢垫片上，放平居中后，用 PTFE 头镊子以低角度慢: Transfer: place the film, still on its release film, onto the SS spacer; once it is flat and centered, slowly peel off the release film at a low angle with PTFE-tipped tweezers. If it sticks, cool it first or change the release film. Work in the glovebox.
原位固化：先把液态前驱体滴进放在不锈钢垫片上的环形垫片孔里，刮平到和环齐平；再用: In-situ curing: first drop the liquid precursor into the hole of the ring spacer sitting on the SS spacer and scrape it flush with the ring; then cure with UV light or heat, place the top spacer and crimp.
配前驱体：可交联单体或低聚物、干燥过的锂盐和增塑剂、光引发剂，在手套箱里装进避光: Preparing the precursor: crosslinkable monomer or oligomer, dried Li salt and plasticizer, and photoinitiator. In the glovebox, put them in a light-proof amber bottle and stir until fully dissolved. Heat only gently to avoid premature crosslinking. The photoinitiator absorption wavelength must match the UV lamp.
增塑剂什么时候加：溶剂浇铸路线先浇铸并真空干燥到恒重，再在手套箱里加增塑剂并称重: When to add plasticizer: on the solvent-casting route, cast and vacuum dry to constant weight first, then add the plasticizer in the glovebox and weigh. On the solvent-free UV route, mix all liquid components and cure directly; no drying is needed and no plasticizer is lost. After adding plasticizer, do not vacuum dry for long periods.
除气泡：前驱体里的气泡固化后会变成孔洞；静置或离心除泡，抽真空要短而温和，因为挥: Removing bubbles: bubbles in the precursor become voids after curing. Remove them by letting it stand or by centrifuging; keep any vacuum short and gentle, because volatile plasticizer is pulled off too. Weigh before and after.
填孔、加盖片、固化：前驱体稍微多填进环形垫片的孔，盖上透紫外的石英片或 PET: Filling, cover sheet and curing: slightly overfill the hole of the ring spacer with precursor, then lay a UV-transparent quartz plate or PET film on the ring and press so the excess squeezes out. In the glovebox, cure through the cover sheet with 365 nm UV, then peel off the cover sheet and place the spacer.
检查固化：整片固化、表面不粘可以测；表面发粘是氧阻聚或剂量不够，加盖片或延长照射: Checking the cure: a fully cured film with a non-tacky surface can be measured. A tacky surface means oxygen inhibition or too low a dose; add a cover sheet or extend the exposure. A gap at the edge is cure shrinkage; fill another layer and cure again. A tacky bottom means the layer is too thick or absorbs too strongly. IR can show whether the C=C double-bond peak at 1635 cm⁻¹ has disappeared.
测量时监控增塑剂：恒温下隔一段时间测一次电导率，稳定才可信，一直下降说明增塑剂在: Monitoring plasticizer during measurement: at constant temperature, measure conductivity at intervals; only a stable value is reliable, and a steady decline means the plasticizer is evaporating or leaching out. Weigh before and after the test, and open the cell to check whether the surface is wet or oily. In the report, state the plasticizer type, content and mass change.
截面图：上下两块不锈钢板之间是开孔 PTFE 垫片，孔里是厚度为 L 的样品；孔: Cross section: between the upper and lower stainless steel plates is a PTFE spacer with a hole, and the hole holds a sample of thickness L. The hole diameter d sets the area A. Ions migrate through the sample and are blocked at the stainless steel surfaces.
接线图：绿色和蓝色导线从左上方各用一个鳄鱼夹夹在上板接线片；白色、红色、橙色导线: Wiring diagram: the green and blue leads come from the upper left, each with an alligator clip on the upper plate's tab; the white, red and orange leads run from below around to the right, each with an alligator clip on the lower plate's tab; the black floating-ground lead is left unconnected or connected to the Faraday shield.
三种纽扣电池的 Nyquist 图示意：不锈钢阻塞电池是半圆加低频尖峰，用来测离: Schematic Nyquist plots of three kinds of coin cell: an SS blocking cell shows a semicircle plus a low-frequency spike and is used to measure ionic conductivity; a Li symmetric cell shows a bulk intercept plus an interfacial semicircle; a half cell or full cell shows an ohmic intercept, SEI and charge-transfer semicircles, then a 45-degree diffusion tail.
五种纽扣电池的叠层：SS 电解质 SS 测离子电导率和电子电导；SS PTFE: Stacks of five coin cells: SS | electrolyte | SS measures ionic conductivity and electronic conductivity; SS | PTFE | SS is the blank cell for electronic conductivity; Li | electrolyte | Li measures transference number, symmetric cycling and critical current density; SS | electrolyte | Li measures the stability window; SS | wetted separator | SS measures the effective conductivity of a liquid electrolyte. All are assembled from bottom to top.
CR2032 纽扣电池分层图，从下往上：正极壳、不锈钢垫片（下电极）、电解质膜或: CR2032 coin cell layer diagram, from bottom to top: positive case, SS spacer (bottom electrode), electrolyte film or wetted separator (thickness L), SS spacer (top electrode), spring, gasket, negative cap. Area A is calculated from the spacer diameter d.
组装前准备：每个电池一套 CR2032 零件，包括正极壳、带密封圈的负极盖、两片: Preparation before assembly: one set of CR2032 parts per cell, including positive case, negative cap with gasket, two SS spacers, spring and electrolyte film, plus Li foils for lithium cells. Tools: plastic or ceramic tweezers, punch, micrometer, crimper and CR2032 die. Assemble cells that contain lithium or are water-sensitive in the glovebox.
清洗和干燥零件：不锈钢垫片、正极壳和负极盖用乙醇或异丙醇超声清洗，烘干后经过渡舱: Cleaning and drying parts: ultrasonically clean the SS spacers, positive cases and negative caps in ethanol or isopropanol, dry them, and bring them into the glovebox through the antechamber. Handle parts only with tweezers; spacer surfaces must be flat and free of scratches and rust spots.
冲膜并测量：用冲刀冲出例如直径 19 毫米的膜，边缘整齐；千分尺测 5 个点取平: Punching and measuring the film: punch a film of, for example, 19 mm diameter with clean edges. Measure 5 points with a micrometer and take the average as thickness L; re-measure the diameter d after punching. For lithium cells, also punch Li foils a size smaller than the film, for example 14 to 16 mm, and scrape them lightly until shiny if dull. Record L, d and the Li foil diameter. Use the weighing method for soft films.
放正极壳和下电极：正极壳开口朝上放在干净的绝缘垫上，用镊子把下垫片放在壳的正中，: Placing the positive case and bottom electrode: set the positive case open side up on a clean insulating mat and use tweezers to place the bottom spacer in its center, concentric when viewed from above. For a Li symmetric cell, first press a Li foil onto the bottom spacer, Li side up; for an SS | Li cell, place only the spacer at the bottom.
放电解质膜：左边正确，膜放在下垫片正中，平整并盖住垫片；右边错误，膜偏心、有气泡: Placing the electrolyte film: left, correct: the film sits centered on the bottom spacer, flat and covering the spacer. Right, wrong: the film is off-center with bubbles and wrinkles; where the spacer is exposed, the top and bottom electrodes may touch. For soft, sticky films, place a PP or PTFE ring first. For liquid electrolyte, add a fixed volume after placing the separator.
放上电极和弹片：上垫片对齐下垫片放在膜上，再把弹片放在中心；锂对称电池和 SS: Placing the top electrode and spring: place the top spacer on the film, aligned with the bottom spacer, then place the spring in the center. For Li symmetric and SS | Li cells, press a Li foil onto the top spacer, Li side down facing the film. If the top and bottom spacers are misaligned, the effective area is less than A.
盖负极盖并封口：把带密封圈的负极盖扣在弹片上，盖平，密封圈不能挤出；按封口机说明: Closing with the negative cap and crimping: press the negative cap with gasket onto the spring, sitting level, without squeezing out the gasket. Following the crimper instructions, place the cell in the CR2032 die, apply the set pressure and hold for a few seconds.
封口后检查：用异丙醇擦净外壳，壳上写编号；万用表检查读数：SS 对称池电阻很大并: Checks after crimping: wipe the case clean with isopropanol and write a number on it. Multimeter readings: an SS symmetric cell shows a very high resistance that slowly rises; an SS | PTFE | SS blank cell shows OL; a Li symmetric cell reads about 0 mV; for an SS | Li cell, record the open-circuit voltage. Close to 0 ohms means a short; reassemble. For a charged cell, use only the voltage range.
纽扣电池接线：绿、蓝接正极壳，白、红、橙接负极盖；四线夹具每面一个电流触点、一个: Coin cell wiring: green and blue to the positive case; white, red and orange to the negative cap. A four-wire holder has one current contact and one sense contact on each face. With alligator clips, clip only the centers of the two flat faces; a clip biting the rim shorts the positive and negative terminals.
纽扣电池怎么接到 Reference 620 电缆：现在的电缆是五根没有夹子的: How to connect a coin cell to the Reference 620 cable: the present cable has five 2 mm banana plugs without clips, and the black lead has a clip. As a stopgap, use alligator clips with 2 mm sockets: clip the current leads to the centers of the two flat faces and clip the sense leads onto the current clips; do not clip the rim. Recommended: buy a four-wire coin cell holder. Red to the negative cap current contact, white and orange to the negative cap sense contact, blue to the positive case sense contact, green to the positive case current contact. 4 mm sockets need 2 mm female to 4 mm male adapters.
四线纽扣电池夹具结构：侧视图中弹簧夹的两片绝缘夹臂（PEEK 或 PTFE）夹住: Four-wire coin cell holder construction: in the side view, the two insulating jaws (PEEK or PTFE) of a spring clamp hold a CR2032 with the negative cap facing up. Each jaw has two gold-plated contacts on its inner face, one for the current lead and one for the sense lead, pressing on the center of the flat face. In the top view of the contact face, the two half-disc contacts are insulated from each other and must not touch the crimped rim at the cell edge. Wiring: upper jaw current contact to red CE, sense contact to white RE and orange CS; lower jaw current contact to green WE, sense contact to blue WS; black lead to the shield.
四线纽扣电池夹具：上下两个绝缘夹臂各有两块触点，电流触点 I 和感应触点 V；上: Four-wire coin cell holder: the upper and lower insulating jaws each have two contacts, a current contact I and a sense contact V. On top, the negative cap side connects to red CE and white RE; on the bottom, the positive case side connects to green WE and blue WS. The contact resistance of the contacts and leads is not included in the result. Before use, check that the contacts are clean and flat, and wipe them with isopropanol.
把电池放进夹具：负极盖朝向接红线和白线的一面，触点压在平面中心；触点碰到边缘翻边: Placing the cell in the holder: the negative cap faces the side wired to the red and white leads, with the contacts pressing on the center of the flat faces. Contacts touching the crimped rim is wrong: the rim belongs to the positive case and would short the positive and negative terminals. Squeeze the hand clip open, push the cell all the way in, release, and check all four contacts. Wipe the cell case clean first.
接仪器前用万用表检查夹具接触：第一项，同一面的两根线，绿和蓝、红和白之间应导通，: Checking holder contact with a multimeter before connecting the instrument. Check 1, the two leads on the same face: green and blue, and red and white, should be continuous, about 0 ohms; no continuity means a contact is not pressing properly. Check 2, between the two faces: an SS symmetric cell shows a very high resistance that slowly rises, a PTFE blank cell shows OL, a Li symmetric cell reads about 0 mV, and an SS | Li cell shows its open-circuit voltage. For a charged cell, use only the voltage range between the two faces.
接线，在 Cell On 熄灭时进行：负极盖一面的电流触点接红 CE，感应触点接: Wiring, done while Cell On is off: on the negative cap face, the current contact goes to red CE and the sense contact to white RE, with orange CS joined to the white lead. On the positive case face, the current contact goes to green WE and the sense contact to blue WS. Black lead to the shield. For an SS | Li cell, the stainless steel side goes to green and blue.
放进法拉第屏蔽盒或金属恒温箱：黑线接箱体，夹具和导线不碰箱壁，两组导线分开走，热: Placing the cell in the Faraday shield or a metal oven: connect the black lead to the enclosure; keep the holder and leads off the walls, route the two lead groups apart, and place the thermocouple next to the holder. After reaching temperature, wait another 30 to 60 minutes. When measuring picoamp currents, the shield must be closed. Metal enclosures are often earth grounded, so the electrodes and holder must not touch the enclosure.
测完取出：先等 Cell On 黄灯熄灭，再拔导线、打开夹具，用塑料镊子取出电池: Removing after the test: first wait for the yellow Cell On light to go out, then unplug the leads, open the holder, take out the cell with plastic tweezers and handle it per after-test handling. Wipe the contacts with isopropanol and let them air dry. After high-temperature tests the holder and cell are hot; wear heat-resistant gloves or wait for them to cool. Tape both terminals of a charged cell with insulating tape.
分辨两种 PP 膜：微孔 PP 隔膜是白色不透明的，滴乙醇后被吸进去、变成半透明: Telling the two PP films apart: microporous PP separator is opaque white; a drop of ethanol soaks in and turns it translucent. It is used to hold liquid electrolyte. Dense PP film is clear and glossy; ethanol only spreads over the surface and the film does not change. It is suitable for cutting into ring spacers.
冲片和干燥：PP 隔膜冲成直径 19 毫米、比 16 毫米垫片大一圈的圆片；真空: Punching and drying: punch the PP separator into 19 mm discs, a size larger than the 16 mm spacer. Vacuum dry, then bring into the glovebox; set the temperature per your group's protocol, commonly about 60 °C.
量厚度：把 4 层隔膜叠在一起用千分尺量，读数 0.100 毫米除以 4 层，单: Measuring thickness: stack 4 layers of separator and measure with a micrometer; the reading of 0.100 mm divided by 4 layers gives a single-layer thickness L1 of 25 µm.
组装和加液：从下往上依次放正极壳、不锈钢垫片、PP 隔膜，滴加电解液浸透整片隔膜: Assembly and filling: from bottom to top, place the positive case, SS spacer and PP separator; add electrolyte dropwise until the whole separator is soaked; then place the SS spacer, spring and negative cap, and finally crimp.
静置浸润：刚加液时隔膜白色不透明，浸润中从中间开始变透明，浸透后整片半透明；PP: Resting to wet: right after the liquid is added the separator is opaque white; while wetting it turns transparent starting from the center, and when fully soaked the whole disc is translucent. PP is hydrophobic, so rest for several hours before measuring, or take the value once the intercept stops changing.
多层法：1 到 4 层隔膜的高频截距对层数作直线，斜率约 1.41 欧姆每层，是: Multilayer method: plot the high-frequency intercept against the number of separator layers, 1 to 4, as a straight line. The slope, about 1.41 ohms per layer, is the resistance of each separator layer; the intercept, about 0.43 ohms, is the case and contact resistance.
计算：有效电导率 σeff 等于单层厚度除以每层电阻乘面积，示例 0.0025: Calculation: the effective conductivity σeff equals the single-layer thickness divided by the product of per-layer resistance and area. Example: 0.0025 cm divided by (1.41 ohms times 2.01 cm²), about 0.88 mS/cm. The MacMullin number NM equals the conductivity of the electrolyte itself divided by σeff, about 11 in the example.
多层法：高频截距 R 对隔膜层数 n 的直线拟合: Multilayer method: linear fit of the high-frequency intercept R against the number of separator layers n
致密 PP 薄膜做环形垫片：俯视图中 PP 环外圆不小于垫片，中心孔填满电解质，: Dense PP film as a ring spacer: in the top view, the outer edge of the PP ring is no smaller than the spacer, the center hole is filled with electrolyte, and the hole diameter d sets the area A. In the cross section, two SS spacers press on the PP ring, and L equals the PP ring thickness.
Gamry Framework 的 Experiment 菜单里只用 A、E、G: In the Experiment menu of Gamry Framework, only groups A, E and G are used, with J available for cycling: A Utilities for calibration; in E Physical Electrochemistry, chronoamperometry, linear sweep, cyclic voltammetry and chronopotentiometry; in G Electrochemical Impedance, potentiostatic EIS; J Electrochemical Energy for Li symmetric cycling.
仪器就绪：Power 蓝灯常亮、USB 绿灯常亮；自检通过、Calibrate: Instrument ready: blue Power light steady on, green USB light steady on; self-test passed and Calibrate Instrument completed. For high-impedance samples, also run the Low I DC calibration and the cable capacitance calibration.
用千分尺量样品厚度 L，多点测量取平均；俯视图中量直径 d，A 等于 π d 平: Measure the sample thickness L with a micrometer at several points and average. In the top view, measure the diameter d; A equals π times d squared divided by 4.
装池：从下往上依次放下板、带样品的垫片、上板；俯视图中两根尼龙螺栓按 1、2、1: Assembling the cell: from bottom to top, place the bottom plate, the spacer with the sample, and the top plate. In the top view, tighten the two nylon bolts alternately in small steps, in the order 1, 2, 1, 2; do not overtighten.
用万用表电阻挡量两个接线片：显示 OL 或兆欧级并缓慢上升为正常；接近 0 欧姆: Measure across the two tabs on the multimeter resistance range: OL, or megohms slowly rising, is normal; close to 0 ohms means the two plates are shorted; disassemble and reassemble.
控温：电解池放进恒温箱，自备的 K 型热电偶接到 Reference 620 后: Temperature control: place the cell in the oven and connect your own Type K thermocouple to the T/C Type K jack on the rear panel of the Reference 620. Start measuring only after the temperature curve reaches the set point and has been stable for a while.
软件界面示意：Gamry Framework 菜单 Experiment、Ele: Software interface schematic: Gamry Framework menu Experiment, Electrochemical Impedance, Potentiostatic EIS. Parameter box: initial frequency 1 MHz, final frequency 0.1 Hz, 10 points per decade, AC 10 mV rms, DC 0 V vs Eoc, area 1 cm².
运行中：先测开路电位，Cell On 不亮；开始扫频后 Cell On 亮黄灯，: Running: the open-circuit potential is measured first, with Cell On not lit. Once the frequency sweep starts, the yellow Cell On light comes on and Nyquist points appear one by one from high to low frequency. Do not touch the leads during the measurement; if Overload stays lit, check the clips.
读谱：Nyquist 图中半圆右端与实轴的交点给出 R_s 加 R_b；更准的做: Reading the spectrum: in the Nyquist plot, the real-axis intercept at the right end of the semicircle gives R_s plus R_b. A more accurate approach is to fit in Echem Analyst 2 with the equivalent circuit R_s in series with R_b parallel to a CPE, then in series with a CPE, and take R_b.
计算：σ 等于 L 除以 R_b 乘 A，示例 0.0100 cm 除以 127: Calculation: σ equals L divided by (R_b times A). Example: 0.0100 cm divided by (1273 ohms times 0.785 cm²) equals 1.00 times 10 to the minus 5 S/cm. Assemble three cells for repeat measurements and report the mean and standard deviation.
测之前确认校准：开机、Calibrate Instrument 做过即可、当天做: Confirm calibration before measuring: power on; a completed Calibrate Instrument is enough; run the Low I DC calibration on the same day; then assemble the cell and measure. Wire the Low I DC calibration as the software window shows; cable capacitance calibration is not needed.
估算电流：刚加电压时离子电流约毫安级，几小时内衰减到皮安到纳安级的电子电流，跨好: Estimating the current: right after the voltage is applied, the ionic current is in the milliamp range; within a few hours it decays to an electronic current in the picoamp to nanoamp range, spanning several orders of magnitude. This needs a Faraday shield and the Low I DC calibration; set the range to Auto.
空白池：用绝缘的 PTFE 膜代替电解质，装成同样的夹具测一次，背景电流应该远小: Blank cell: replace the electrolyte with an insulating PTFE film, assemble it in the same holder and measure once. The background current should be much smaller than the steady-state current of the sample; subtract it in the calculation.
装池接线和屏蔽：SS 电解质 SS 电池放在法拉第屏蔽盒或接了黑线的金属恒温箱里: Cell assembly, wiring and shielding: place the SS | electrolyte | SS cell in a Faraday shield or in a metal oven connected to the black lead. Green and blue go to one plate; white, red and orange go to the other plate; black lead to the shield.
控温：温度到达设定值并稳定 30 到 60 分钟以上再开始极化，测量全程保持恒温: Temperature control: start polarization only after the temperature reaches the set point and has been stable for 30 to 60 minutes or longer. Keep the temperature constant throughout the measurement and avoid drafts and vibration.
极化前测 EIS：读出本体电阻 R_b，算离子电导率；谱图只是实轴附近一个点说明: EIS before polarization: read the bulk resistance R_b and calculate the ionic conductivity. A spectrum that is only a single point near the real axis means the two plates are shorted; disassemble and reassemble.
选电压：用另一个 SS 电解质 SS 电池慢扫 LSV 找到电流开始明显上升的分: Choosing voltages: on another SS | electrolyte | SS cell, run a slow LSV to find the decomposition voltage where the current starts to rise clearly; choose 2 to 3 voltages well below it, for example 0.1, 0.25 and 0.5 V.
计时电流法设置：预步 0 伏 30 秒；第一步 0.100 伏、2 到 10 小: Chronoamperometry setup: pre-step 0 V for 30 s; step 1 at 0.100 V for 2 to 10 hours; step 2 at 0 V for the same time as step 1; sample period 5 to 10 s; range Auto; area 1 cm²; vs Eref only for SS cells that store no charge.
运行并判断稳态：对数纵轴上电流从毫安级迅速下降，几小时后到纳安级平台；最后 1: Running and judging steady state: on a logarithmic vertical axis, the current drops quickly from the milliamp range and after several hours reaches a nanoamp plateau. When the change over the last hour is less than 1 to 2%, take the average as the steady-state current. Step 2 returns to 0 V and the reverse current decays.
多个电压：0.1、0.25、0.5 伏从低到高依次极化，每次之后回 0 伏静置，: Multiple voltages: polarize at 0.1, 0.25 and 0.5 V in order from low to high, returning to 0 V to rest after each for at least as long as the polarization; or use a new cell for each voltage.
极化后测 EIS：和极化前的谱图基本重合说明数据可用；R_b 明显变化说明样品分: EIS after polarization: if the spectrum essentially overlaps the one before polarization, the data are usable. A clear change in R_b means the sample decomposed, was compressed thinner or shorted, and this data set is not reliable.
计算：扣掉空白电流后，稳态电流对电压作图，取过原点直线的斜率，电子电导等于 L: Calculation: after subtracting the blank current, plot steady-state current against voltage and take the slope of a straight line through the origin. Electronic conductivity equals L divided by A, times the slope; example about 5.0 times 10 to the minus 11 S/cm. Do not use points that curve upward at high voltage. The ionic transference number is close to 1.
稳态电流对电压，过原点直线拟合: Steady-state current against voltage, linear fit through the origin
装锂对称电池并静置：Li 电解质 Li，膜比锂片大一圈；在测试温度下隔一段时间测: Assembling the Li symmetric cell and resting: Li | electrolyte | Li, with the film a size larger than the Li foils. At the test temperature, measure EIS at intervals; start the transference number measurement only after the interfacial semicircle stops changing.
极化前 EIS：小半圆是本体电阻 R_b,0，接着的大半圆是界面电阻 R_0；用: EIS before polarization: the small semicircle is the bulk resistance R_b,0, and the following large semicircle is the interfacial resistance R_0. Fit with the equivalent circuit R_s in series with R_b parallel to a CPE, then in series with R_i parallel to a CPE. Program: G Potentiostatic EIS, 1 MHz to 0.1 Hz, AC 5 to 10 mV, DC 0 V vs Eoc.
迁移数的计时电流设置：预步 0 伏 vs Eoc 10 秒；第一步 0.010: Chronoamperometry setup for the transference number: pre-step 0 V vs Eoc for 10 s; step 1 at 0.010 V vs Eoc for 1 to 5 hours; step 2 at 0 V, very short; sampling 1 to 5 s; maximum current no less than ΔV divided by the sum of bulk and interfacial resistance; iR compensation off.
恒电位极化：加 10 毫伏后电流从初始值 I0 衰减到稳态 Iss，30 到 6: Potentiostatic polarization: after 10 mV is applied, the current decays from the initial value I0 to the steady state Iss. When it changes by less than about 1% over 30 to 60 minutes, average the last stretch. I0 can be taken as the current at the start of the curve, or calculated as ΔV divided by the sum of bulk and interfacial resistance.
极化后立即测 EIS：Init. Delay 关掉；用同一个等效电路拟合，界面电: EIS immediately after polarization: turn Init. Delay off. Fit with the same equivalent circuit; the interfacial resistance changes from R0 before polarization to Rss after polarization.
计算迁移数：t+ 等于 Iss 乘 ΔV 减 I0 R0，除以 I0 乘 ΔV: Calculating the transference number: t+ equals Iss times (ΔV minus I0 R0), divided by I0 times (ΔV minus Iss Rss); example about 0.29. Check that t+ is between 0 and 1, that Iss is less than I0, and that the measured and calculated I0 are close. Repeat with 2 to 3 cells.
稳定窗口的电池：SS 电解质 Li，锂在负极盖一侧作对电极兼参比，不锈钢是工作电: Cell for the stability window: SS | electrolyte | Li. The lithium on the negative cap side serves as both counter and reference electrode, and the stainless steel is the working electrode. Green and blue go to the stainless steel; white, red and orange go to the lithium. In the software, vs Eref means vs Li. Use a new cell for each scan.
线性扫描伏安设置：起始 0 伏 vs Eoc，终止 6.0 伏 vs Eref: Linear sweep voltammetry setup: initial 0 V vs Eoc, final 6.0 V vs Eref, that is vs Li; scan rate 0.1 to 1 mV/s; step size 1 to 2 mV; range Auto; iR compensation off; initial delay until the open-circuit potential is stable.
读氧化极限：电流密度对电位作图，先定判据，例如电流密度超过 10 微安每平方厘米: Reading the oxidation limit: plot current density against potential and define a criterion first, for example the potential at which the current density exceeds 10 µA/cm²; about 5.3 V vs Li in the example. In the report, state the scan rate, temperature, working electrode and criterion.
还原侧：用新的 SS 电解质 Li 电池做循环伏安，−0.5 到 3 伏 vs: Reduction side: use a new SS | electrolyte | Li cell for cyclic voltammetry from −0.5 to 3 V vs Li. The reduction peak near 0 V is lithium plating on stainless steel, and the oxidation peak on the return scan is lithium stripping, not electrolyte decomposition.
锂对称循环设置：电流 I 等于电流密度 j 乘锂片面积，示例 0.1 毫安每平方: Li symmetric cycling setup: current I equals current density j times the Li foil area; example: 0.1 mA/cm² with a 12 mm Li foil gives 0.113 mA. Alternate positive and negative. Commonly 0.5 to 1 hour per half cycle, with a voltage limit of, for example, ±1 V. Program: J cyclic charge-discharge, or chained chronopotentiometry steps.
正常的锂对称循环曲线：电压正负交替，每半周的平台一样高，说明界面稳定；平台高度是: Normal Li symmetric cycling curve: the voltage alternates positive and negative, and the plateau of every half cycle has the same height, meaning the interfaces are stable. The plateau height is the overpotential at both sides plus the iR drop.
异常的锂对称循环：左边电压平台逐渐变大，说明界面恶化；右边电压突然变小并变得杂乱: Abnormal Li symmetric cycling: left, the voltage plateau gradually grows, meaning the interface is degrading; right, the voltage suddenly drops and becomes erratic, meaning a short circuit caused by Li dendrites.
临界电流密度：电流密度每个循环加 0.05 毫安每平方厘米，电压平台随之升高，到: Critical current density: the current density increases by 0.05 mA/cm² each cycle and the voltage plateau rises with it; at some step the voltage suddenly drops to near 0, and that step is the critical current density. Report the step before the short and the step at which it shorted.
实验结束：Cell On 黄灯熄灭后，松开夹具触点，取出纽扣电池。: End of the experiment: after the yellow Cell On light goes out, release the holder contacts and take out the coin cell.
记录：在电池壳上写编号；记下编号、样品批次、L 和 A、温度、数据文件名和开路电: Records: write a number on the cell case; record the number, sample batch, L and A, temperature, data file name and open-circuit voltage. Repeat the measurement twice; the spectra should essentially overlap.
外观检查：平整干净的电池可以继续；鼓胀、漏液或边缘有白色结晶、发热的电池不要拆，: Visual inspection: a flat, clean cell can go on to the next step. Do not open a cell that is swollen, leaking, has white crystals at the edge or is hot; isolate it in a fireproof container and report to the person in charge.
按电池类型处理：不锈钢阻塞电池不带电、无锂金属，可以直接拆；锂对称电池含锂金属，: Handle by cell type: SS blocking cells are not charged and contain no lithium metal, and can be opened directly; Li symmetric cells contain lithium metal and are opened in the glovebox; half cells and full cells are charged: discharge them first and wrap both terminals with insulating tape.
拆壳：用专用拆壳器或绝缘钳撬开翻边，取下负极盖，工具不要同时碰到盖和壳；含锂金属: Opening the case: pry open the crimped rim with a dedicated decrimping tool or insulated pliers and remove the negative cap; the tool must not touch the cap and the case at the same time. Open cells with lithium metal or LiPF6 electrolyte in the glovebox; LiPF6 forms HF on contact with water. Wear goggles and gloves.
检查电解质膜：完整的膜和装池时一样；挤出到垫片外面或有破孔都要记录；拆开后复测厚: Inspecting the electrolyte film: an intact film looks the same as at assembly. Record any extrusion beyond the spacer or any holes. Re-measure the thickness after opening; a clear difference from before assembly means the film was compressed thinner during the measurement.
分类处理：放电并贴胶带的电池进电池废物；电解质膜、隔膜和沾电解液的擦拭纸进化学废: Sorting waste: discharged and taped cells go to battery waste; electrolyte films, separators and wipes with electrolyte on them go to chemical waste; passivate lithium metal before disposal, keep it out of regular trash and away from water; SS spacers can be cleaned, dried and reused. Your institution's EHS rules take precedence.
清理：夹具触点用无尘纸蘸异丙醇擦掉电解液残留；电解池电缆导线分开挂好，金属头不互: Cleanup: wipe electrolyte residue off the holder contacts with lint-free wipes dampened with isopropanol; hang the cell cable leads apart so their metal ends do not touch each other. If the instrument will not be used again that day, shut it down per the operating SOP.
